evidence: A commenter runs LanguageTool on premises and describes it as incredibly reliable, while noting subscription restrictions on some plugins.

evidence_sources.author: davidee
evidence_sources.excerpt: We use a self-hosted OSS LanguageTool server that's containerized and runs in a private, on-prem cluster to provide good performance and be HA, but it only works on our corporate network or when using a VPN connection while roaming/remote. It's incredibly reliable.

source_story_title: Grammarly will send unhinged messages to all your users if you try to cancel
